title: Using config-inline to declare a Dockerhub mirror has no effect
body:
### Behaviour

My company is using a Dockerhub mirror (direct access to the Internet in the build context is not possible) which I want to combine with the Buildx setup action like [shown in this documentation](https://docs.docker.com/build/ci/github-actions/configure-builder/#registry-mirror). So far, I had no success with this. The actual build steps always try to contact the real Dockerhub instead of the mirror.

#### Steps to reproduce this issue

1. Configure a GitHub pipeline with the setup action configured to use a mirror
2. Re-use the configured builder in the pipeline step for building images
3. Create some Dockerfile that extends an image from Dockerhub
4. Run the pipeline in GitHub

#### Expected behaviour

I expect that images built by Buildx would honor the mirror configured for Dockerhub and thus pull base images not from _registry-1.docker.io_ but from the mirror site.

#### Actual behaviour

Buildx (according to the output) relentlessly tries to contact Dockerhub directly:

> Error: buildx bake failed with: ERROR: failed to solve: DeadlineExceeded: DeadlineExceeded: DeadlineExceeded: centos:8.3.2011: failed to do request: Head "https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/library/centos/manifests/8.3.2011": dial tcp 34.194.164.123:443: i/o timeout

### Configuration

```yml
    steps:
      -
        name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v2
        id: setup-builder
        with:
          config-inline: |
            [registry."docker.io"]
              mirrors = ["dockerhub-remote.artifactory.company.int"]
      -
        name: Build and push
        uses: docker/bake-action@v2
        with:
          builder: ${{ steps.setup-builder.outputs.name }}
          workdir: ${{ matrix.image }}
          push: true
```
